phase: Fiscal Reaction Selective Reopen — CAPB Real-Time Information-Set Timing Adjudication

source_materialisation.reason: Exact raw ZIP bytes and the original inventory are present in the reviewed GitHub Actions artifact and hash-identified. The repository retains exact selected-row evidence plus normalized review tables, but not the raw ZIP set or a byte-identical inventory copy. The canonical source-vintage contract therefore forbids a no-refetch exact reproducibility claim.

timing_rule.official_ameco_metadata_rule: Spring forecasts cover two forecast years and Autumn forecasts three forecast years, including the current year; AMECO text files do not directly flag forecast versus historical observations.
timing_rule.caveat: AMECO notes that for some series the most recent completed year can still be forecast. UBLGBPS is therefore treated as a release-time historical estimate rather than a final actual observation; no later vintage may be backfilled into an earlier information set.

public_archive_extension_ceiling.note: Official archive endpoints are identified, but UBLGBPS presence in each 2011-2021 payload is not yet source-probed.

revision_diagnostics.interpretation: Revision magnitudes are material enough that latest-vintage backfill would contaminate a real-time fiscal reaction design.

sample_size_adjudication.reason: Even the maximum public Spring/Autumn archive window cannot reproduce the prior 29-target-year calibration/selection/final-evaluation discipline. A weaker evaluation design must not be introduced merely to rescue the mechanism.

next_gate: Preregister and execute a source-structure-only probe of the official Spring/Autumn 2011-2021 AMECO archives for exact Romania UBLGBPS presence, while separately solving permanent repository retention of the already reviewed 2022-2026 raw bytes. Do not preregister a new reaction-function selection design unless the resulting sample can support an independently justified validation structure rather than a weakened rescue design.
